messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nTeams need reserves to reflect real-time changes but are forced to rely on manual overrides and delayed integrations. This slows down decision-making and increases errors.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Sales teams, who have raised this issue in 3 mentions from 3 accounts [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n\n## Evidence\n- The problem has been mentioned 3 times by 3 accounts [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- All 3 mentions came via the sales route [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- Quarrendon Commercial requested a demo to see how a solution handles real-time reserves updates [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- Duncastle Auto stated a need for smoother integrations and real-time updates [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].\n- Brindlecombe Home highlighted the need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- The total ARR from accounts mentioning this issue is 80000.0 GBP [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].\n- 0 renewals are due in the next 90 days for these accounts.\n\n## Why now\n- The most recent mention was on 2026-10-27 [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- The issue has been raised consistently over a six-week period, from 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-27 [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- One account with an ARR of 80000.0 GBP has a renewal date set for 2027-08-19 [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "5388e3c55d08eb93",
   "quote": "That’s exactly the kind of control we need...Can we schedule a demo next week to see how it handles real-time reserves updates?",
   "account": "Quarrendon Commercial",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-27T11:37:00Z"
  },
  {
   "id": "5d8a32853c6dd995",
   "quote": "Just the basics — smoother integrations, real-time updates, and less manual chasing.",
   "account": "Duncastle Auto",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
  },
  {
   "id": "91bb9d5bd85ff69d",
   "quote": "That’s a key point for us — we need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides.",
   "account": "Brindlecombe Home",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-09-15T08:35:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 3,
  "mentions_n": 3,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 3
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 80000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Quarrendon Commercial",
    "arr_gbp": null,
    "renewal_date": null,
    "mentions": 1
   },
   {
    "name": "Duncastle Auto",
    "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
    "mentions": 1
   },
   {
    "name": "Brindlecombe Home",
    "arr_gbp": null,
    "renewal_date": null,
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I verified the mention count (3 mentions from 3 accounts) against the fact sheet and cited insights, which match. I checked the ARR claim of 80000.0 GBP — this belongs solely to Duncastle Auto and equals the fact sheet total, so it's accurate. The renewal claims (0 renewals in 90 days; the 80000 GBP account renewing 2027-08-19) match the fact sheet. The date range 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-27 spans about six weeks, and all cited quotes are direct, not paraphrased in quotation marks. All mentions came via the sales route as stated, and the per-account paraphrases accurately reflect the cited quotes.", "verdict": "pass"}
